simple.meaning: גָּבֹהַּ (gâbôahh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “elevated (or elated), powerful , arrogant.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 7:19. The surrounding context includes family line, kingship, land, mountain, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גָּבֹהַּ (H1364) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: גָּבֹהַּ (gâbôahh) / H1364 is traced through Genesis 7:19, Deuteronomy 3:5, Deuteronomy 28:52, 1 Samuel 2:3 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H1364. gaboah גָּבֹהַּ adjective high, exalted — 1Sam 9:2 15 t.; גָּבוֺהַּ Psa 138:6 ; construct גְּבֹהַּ 1Sam 16:7 ; גְּבַהּ (Ew § 213 d ) Psa 101:5 3 t.; plural גְּבֹהִים Eccl 5:7 5 t.; feminine גְּבֹהָה Deut 3:5-6 t.; plural גְּבֹהוֺת Dan 8:3 2 t.; גְּבֹהֹת Deut 28:52 ; — 1 high, lofty, tall , e.g. tree Ezek 17:24 , tower Isa 2:15 ; Zeph 1:16 , mountain Gen 7:19 ; Psa 104:18 ; Isa 40:9 ; 57:7 ; Ezek 17:22 ; 40:2 ; compare phrases גבהה גבעה כל על upon every high hill 1Kin 14:23 ; 2Kin 17:10 ; Jer 2:20 ; הגבהות גבעות על 17:2 ; גָּבֹהַּ עַלכָּֿלהַֿר Isa 30:25 ; Jer 3:6 ; man 1Sam 9:2 ; tree קוֺמָה גְּבַהּ Ezek 31:3 ; horns Dan 8:3 ; walls Deut 3:5 ; 28:52 ; gallows Est 5:14 ; 7:9 ; gate Jer 51:58 ; altar Ezek 41:22 ; high things Job 41:26 ; Eccl 12:5 . 2 exalted in station Ezek 21:31 ; עֲלֵיהֶם וּגְבֹהִים שֹׁמֵר גָּבֹהַּ מֵעַל גָּבֹהַּ כִּי for high one above high one is watching, & the Most High over them Eccl 5:7 so Ew Zö and others, but Vrss De Now and others higher (earthly), potentates over them . 3 haughty Psa 138:6 ; Isa 5:15 ; 10:33 ; 1Sam 2:3 ; גְּבַהּעֵֿינַיִם Psa 101:5 ; ׳ג לֵב Prov 16:5 ; ׳ג רוּחַ Eccl 7:8 . 4. noun [masculine] loftiness , קוֺמַתוֺ גִּבֹהַּ 1Sam 16:7 ; compare גָּדוֺל 10 , p. 153.
